full_judgment: 2. It is the case of plaintiff that suit land originally belonged to Ana Gazi, whose name is recorded in CS khatian No. 37 and published finally, died, leaving sons, Abdul Kadir, who died, leaving 3 sons, Idris Miah, Kala Miah and Chand Miah. They became owner of the property of dag No. 548 by inheritance and in their names SA khatian No. 39 was prepared finally. The aforesaid heirs of Idris Gazi, defendant Nos. 2-5 by registered exchange deed No. 6707 dated 9-10-2003 exchanged 22 decimals of land with plaintiffs and delivered possession and in exchange defendant No. 2-5, got 29 decimals of land from plaintiffs. Defendant No. 1 on 3-6-2005 denied title of plaintiffs, hence the suit.
